style: Palette of deep aquarium teal, jade green and moss lime, with pale lichen highlights and small warm accents only from lamps and the planet core.

images.prompt: Wide side-view shot of one rectangular room floating alone in deep space like a glass-walled terrarium, framed by thick riveted metal wall panels with a square sealed doorway in the middle of each wall. Inside the room, a lanky floppy ragdoll humanoid in a white and teal space suit with a round glass visor floats in mid-air with arms and legs trailing loosely, one hand holding a chunky sci-fi rifle, among drifting mossy boulders, small floating plants, loose rocks and a tumbling supply crate. Outside the room's walls: a starfield, a teal nebula and a distant ringed planet. The lower left of the picture is calm open space.

Side view inside a half-flooded low-gravity cave room: three lanky floppy ragdoll humanoids in mismatched scrap armor tumble and grapple in the air above the water, one gripping another by the wrist and swinging him around, the third reaching for a glowing sword that spins loose between them. Loose rocks, a crate and bubbles float around them. The bottom third of the room is clear green water full of bubbles and small fish, glowing moss covers the rock walls, and a square metal door is set into the right wall.

Side-view cutaway of a big wall of rectangular rooms stacked together like an ant farm or a shelf of dioramas, each room a separate box with its own climate: a snowy room with icicles, a jungle room with hanging vines, a flooded room full of water and fish, a desert room with sand dunes, a dark cavern lit by lava seams, and an empty room open to black space and stars. Thick metal frames separate the rooms, with small square doorways linking neighbours, and wisps of mist, water and heat haze leak through the walls between rooms. A few tiny floating ragdoll figures drift inside some of the rooms.

Tall portrait cover art: in the centre, a lanky floppy ragdoll humanoid in a white and teal space suit with a round glass visor floats upside down with arms and legs splayed, a chunky sci-fi rifle drifting from one hand. Above and behind, a huge blocky mothership built from many lit rectangular modules and girders hangs in space. Far below, the curved bowl-shaped cross-section of a planet shows layered strata and a glowing core at its bottom. The top quarter of the cover is empty starry sky.

Extreme wide cross-section of a whole planet seen from the side, shaped like a giant cup or bowl: dark space and stars at the top, then a pale sky band with clouds, a green and sandy surface layer with tiny trees, then brown underground caverns, an underground sea, a red-orange mantle, and a brilliant glowing core at the very bottom. Small glowing rectangular rooms are embedded at every layer like lit windows, linked by thin vertical shafts that all converge down toward the core.
